For HQ Pack in Eindhoven, we are looking for technical and accurate employees who want to work in a cleanroom environment. Together with your colleagues, you will assemble and process high-tech products for international customers.

Your tasks include:

- Collecting products and processing data in the ERP system
- Assembling products based on technical drawings and work instructions
- Working with hand tools such as screwdrivers and assembly tools
- Cleaning, inspecting, and packaging high-tech components according to cleanroom guidelines
- Performing quality checks and verifying product specifications
- Identifying and reporting deviations during the production process
- Keeping the cleanroom and workplace clean and safe

You will work full-time in a 2-shift schedule:

- Morning shift: 06:00 – 15:00
- Evening shift: 15:00 – 00:00

You will receive an 18% shift allowance for working in shifts.

Must-haves

- vmbo/mbo working and thinking level
- Ability to read technical drawings
- Good command of the English language
- Willingness to work in a 2-shift schedule

Preferred

- Experience in assembly, production, or cleanroom work
- Experience working with hand tools and technical assembly

What your workdays will look like in this role:You’ll be working Monday to Friday in a 2-shift schedule:06:00 – 15:00 and 15:00 – 00:00.

The cleanroom is a highly controlled, sterile environment designed to minimize – and ideally eliminate – contamination during production or research processes. Contaminants can include dust, fibers, airborne microorganisms, fine particles, or chemical vapors. You’ll be responsible for cleaning metal frames and components that are used in industries such as microchip manufacturing. Together with your colleagues, you will also clean all related packaging materials to ensure they meet the highest cleanliness standards required for use in cleanroom environments.

In this position you work in a production environment. Of course you also check the products. In addition, your daily work as a Cleanroom Operator consists of:

- Cleaning high-tech (technical parts) parts according to instructions and protocols
- Carrying out assembly and cleaning work
- Carrying out quality measurements
- Working on the basis of instructions and drawings (Powerpoint)

To be successful in this position, you preferably already have some technical insight / technical experience in a Cleanroom or any other production environment.

You bring commitment and enthusiasm to your work and identify with the following qualities:

- Positive mindset
- Stress-resistant and responsible
- Proactive and involved team player
- Helpful, quality-focused, and safety-oriented

Additionally, you:

- Have a good command of the English language, as all safety protocols, work instructions, and team communication are in English
- Work in a structured and independent manner
- Can read technical drawings and follow detailed work instructions accurately
- Living in the area of Eindhoven, Helmond, Veldhoven or Valkenswaard

- NEN 9140 Training for Workshop Supervisor English language course: NEN 9140 for Workshop Supervisor For Employers, Health and Safety Officers, and EV Supervisors 
This e-learning explains the NEN 9140 standard and its implications for working on electric vehicles in the workshop. Essential knowledge for the EV work supervisor, as it answers the question: what exactly are your responsibilities? 
 Wil je iets vragen? 
Neem dan contact op met Thomas, onze trainingsspecialist of bel naar 030-6087923 . 
 Training Information 
WHY THE NEN 9140 TRAINING FOR WORKSHOP SUPERVISOR 
In electric vehicles, the propulsion system operates at high voltages. These can pose a danger to people who have to work on these vehicles. The employer is responsible for the safety of the staff. This must ensure a safe workplace and the correct instruction of the staff. For example, an occupational health and safety officer can help with this. The EV workshop supervisor (EV-WV) is the one who is actually in charge of the work on e-vehicles. 
In this e-learning you will learn what the NEN 9140 standard entails and what the standard regulates for those who work on e-vehicles in the workshop. You can see which employees are allowed to perform certain activities and how the designation policy works. You will learn about personal protective equipment and tools, and the usefulness and necessity of instruction and training. 
HOW IS THE TRAINING STRUCTURED? 
The e-learning will be available to you immediately after purchase. The time investment is about 2 hours.
